query: Provide the finalized V‑Dem indicator list mapped to vertical cohesion, each indicator's year coverage, and a protocol for handling non‑concurrent V‑Dem and Afrobarometer waves.

response.query: Provide the finalized V‑Dem indicator list mapped to vertical cohesion, each indicator's year coverage, and a protocol for handling non‑concurrent V‑Dem and Afrobarometer waves.
response.answer: The V-Dem indicator list includes 531 indicators and 95 indices, with annual coverage from 1900 to 2024. Non-concurrent V-Dem and Afrobarometer waves are handled by aligning data based on the closest available years.

results.content: V-Dem - Varietes of Democracy. # The V-Dem Dataset. ### Country-Year: V-Dem Full+Others. Includes 531 V-Dem indicators and 95 indices. ### Coder-Level: V-Dem. Data coded by Country Experts and coder-reliability scores from the Measurement Model output. For R users, we recommend to install our vdemdata R package (link to Github), which includes the most recent V-Dem dataset and some useful functions to explore the data. ### Can I compare index scores across versions, e.g. between version 12 and v11.1 of the V-Dem dataset? ### Variable "X" is missing in the dataset that I have downloaded, even though it is included in the accompanied version of the codebook. results.title: Interactive Maps – V-Dem
results.content: V-Dem - Varietes of Democracy | Global Standards, Local Knowledge. V-Dem - Varietes of Democracy. ##### *No data selected.*. #### **Select Parameters**. Note: The scores in these graphs should be interpreted as relatively high or low compared to scores for the same indicator of other polities and years. #### **Selected Indicators**. #### **Select Indicator**. This tool visualizes data by creating a color-coded map to view the distribution of scores for an indicator around the world. ## **Generating a Graph**. A map shows the distribution of scores around the world for one indicator in one year. Details about selected indicators and indices are available in the "Selected Indicators" box at the bottom of the page. ## **Saving a Map**. Save a graph by clicking on the download sign (three-line sign) at the upper right-hand side of the map, then select your preferred format (png, jpeg, pdf, svg). results.title: Country Graph - V-Dem
results.content: | **Scale:** | Model Estimates   Original Scale |. #### **Selected Indicators**. #### **Select a Country**. Select one country/region and multiple indicators/indices. An index is constructed by indicators and components, the former is the lowest level of aggregation while components are sub-indices. The drilling-down function makes it possible to explore the indicators/components included in an index while keeping the index in view. You can select and unselect which of the indicators/components you want to view by clicking on the text labels to the right. Details about selected indicators and indices are available in the "Selected Indicators" box at the bottom of the page. **Tip!** The V-Dem Codebook includes the appendix ‘Structure of Aggregations – All Indices and Indicators’, which illustrates how indicators, components and indices are constructed and related. You can view the V-Dem data on either the ‘model estimates’ or ‘original scale’ options. **Tip!** When viewing many indicators in the ‘model estimates’, you can view the original scale for one indicator at a time simply by ticking the box next to the indicator.
